encounter: P12 play_order 134, E0160 TRAINER_ELMER (ace), Ashen Woods, cap 42
availability_audit: Same chronology anchor as play_order 133: Ashen Woods is entered in C24, immediately after Flannery's Heat Badge raises the cap to 42. Every member is in work/reference-pools/pool-42.json with gate <= 42 and a source map already walked by then. Route 118 and New Mauville sources are deliberately excluded because both sit after Norman grants Surf in C27 - this is why Mega Manectric, the single best answer to a four-member Water/Bug team, is NOT used here even though its stone window is 30. No legendary, mythical, Ultra Beast or Paradox species is used in this fight.
plan: Elmer is three Water/Bug bodies plus Wo-Chien. Flying is 2x into Wo-Chien, Masquerain and Araquanid, and Electric is 2x into Masquerain, Araquanid and Clawitzer, so Serene Grace Air Slash and a Life Orb Thunderbolt between them hit every member for double damage. Tablets of Ruin cuts Attack by 25% and Masquerain adds Intimidate, so the damage is deliberately almost all special. Togekiss redirects Araquanid's Water Bubble Hydro Pump - the largest single attack on their side - off Jolteon, which dies to it. Amoonguss holds Spore for a Quiver Dance Masquerain. Mega Gardevoir is the Mega slot: Pixilate Hyper Voice is 2x into Wo-Chien and Mystical Fire is 2x into both Wo-Chien and Masquerain while dropping their Special Attack, which is the stat this entire opposing team runs on.
